# MS.NOW

> > Political commentary and analysis from MSNBC's Hardball with Chris Matthews and other MSNBC programs, covering elections, policy debates, and American politics.

MS.NOW is an MSNBC digital platform featuring political analysis primarily from Chris Matthews' Hardball show, along with content from Andrea Mitchell Reports, All In, and Jansing & Co. The site archives commentary on major political events, election coverage, and policy debates from the early 2010s.

## Key Topics

- Chris Matthews
- Republican Party
- 2012 Presidential Election
- Tea Party Movement
- Mitt Romney
- Barack Obama
- Republican Primary
- Sarah Palin
- Newt Gingrich
- Michele Bachmann
- Obama Administration
- Fiscal Policy
- Climate Change
- Political Commentary
- MSNBC Analysis

## 2012 Republican Primary Analysis

- [Matthews: Bachmann or Romney – 'Pick your poison'](https://www.ms.now/hardball/matthews-bachmann-or-romney-pick-your-poison-msna26221): Matthews on GOP frontrunners Bachmann and Romney in 2012 primary race
- [Gingrich, a candidate without a campaign](https://www.ms.now/hardball/gingrich-candidate-without-campaign-msna26232): Matthews on Newt Gingrich's 2012 campaign collapse and staff resignations
- [Why the GOP is a tough crowd](https://www.ms.now/hardball/why-the-gop-tough-crowd-msna26029): Analysis of 2012 Republican primary race with Trump and Pawlenty commentary
- [Palin has yet to show her substance](https://www.ms.now/hardball/palin-has-yet-show-her-substance-msna26347): Matthews questions Sarah Palin's authenticity in 2012 election context
- [Romney continues to change his mind](https://www.ms.now/hardball/romney-continues-change-his-mind-msna26068): Ron Reagan on Romney's climate change flip-flops and policy reversals
- [Matthews: America needs more moderate Republicans](https://www.ms.now/hardball/matthews-america-needs-more-moderate-msna26238): Matthews reflects on Massachusetts moderate GOP governors and Romney

## Obama Administration & Policy

- [Let Me Start...](https://www.ms.now/hardball/let-me-start-222-msna26117): S&P credit downgrade reaction, Tea Party, debt crisis political fallout
- [Let Me Start...](https://www.ms.now/hardball/let-me-start-250-msna26224): Obama's Afghanistan withdrawal, GOP primary, Medicare, gay marriage roundup
- [Let Me Start...](https://www.ms.now/hardball/let-me-start-207-msna26013): Obama's leftward speech, Rick Perry, and 2012 election politics roundup
- [Matthews: 'We're back to business!'](https://www.ms.now/hardball/matthews-were-back-business-msna26228): Matthews compares Clinton, Obama, Bush on healthcare, climate, foreign policy
- [Picking Daley a 'bright sign' from White House](https://www.ms.now/hardball/picking-daley-bright-sign-white-msna26331): Matthews praises Obama's appointment of William Daley as chief of staff

## Tea Party & Republican Politics

- [Tea Partiers, Dems broke pork bellies](https://www.ms.now/hardball/tea-partiers-dems-broke-pork-bellies-msna26304): Bipartisan coalition defeats Pentagon fighter engine pork-barrel spending
- [Why the Republican Party is the party of Thatcher](https://www.ms.now/all-in/why-the-republican-party-the-party-msna56057): GOP's embrace of Thatcher's privatization and union-busting ideology
- [Majesty of King's 'Dream' meets Beck's 'nightmare'](https://www.ms.now/hardball/majesty-kings-dream-meets-becks-msna26389): Matthews contrasts MLK's 1963 speech with Glenn Beck rally and Palin

## Major Issues & Crisis Coverage

- ['This is my life right now': Grieving families join the gun-control fight](https://www.ms.now/andrea-mitchell/my-life-right-now-grieving-familie-msna55864): Hadiya Pendleton's parents advocate for gun control and background checks
- [Detroit's cash crisis: Blame the banks?](https://www.ms.now/jansing-co/detroits-cash-crisis-blame-the-banks-msna19783): Detroit's $14B debt crisis, emergency manager debate, and bank foreclosures
- [A dead-serious thought about BP](https://www.ms.now/hardball/dead-serious-thought-about-bp-msna26437): Chris Matthews' commentary on BP's 'legitimate' claims language during oil spill
